newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nat Gas sees savings from restructure.
newsitem.headline: Nat Gas sees savings from restructure.

text.p: Natural Gas Corporation said on Wednesday it saw savings of NZ$3 million in 1997/98 and around $4 million a year thereafter from a restructuring which would shed more than 70 jobs.
Last November the company announced a substantial restructuring of its gas processing and transmission operations at Taranaki in New Zealand's North Island.

"The restructuring will result in a decline in the company's staff numbers from 353 to 280 over the course of the calendar year. Pre-tax provision of NZ$2.2 million, or NZ$1.5 million after tax, has been made in the half-year accounts for redundancy costs," the company said.
It earlier announced net profit of NZ$15.26 million for the half year to December 31, down from $17.86 million a year earlier.

"Savings arising from the restructuring won't have a significant effect on the current year's results, but they are estimated at around NZ$3 million in 1997/98 and approximately NZ$4 million a year thereafter," Natural Gas said.
